_doc: Plantillas de descripción de perks, objetos y consumibles (RT-035). El texto de un efecto NO se escribe a mano: se compone desde el propio dato con estas plantillas, así que descripción y efecto no pueden divergir. Marcadores: {trigger} {condition} {effects} {limit} {target} {who} {tag} {attribute} {duration} {probability} {counter} {value:+} {value:+%} {valuePerCounter:+} {maxValue} {counterDivisor} {ticks} {event} {n} {position} {zone} {detail} {a} {b} {point} {scalar} {dimension} {markTag}. Las claves de 'conditions' son el nombre de la función y, para las funciones que devuelven un número o texto, el nombre más el sufijo de la comparación (Lt, Le, Gt, Ge, Eq, Ne). Secciones del rediseño espacial (paquete S): 'links' nombra las relaciones direccionales de la ADR 0021 (marcador {link}), 'immunities' los efectos de tipo immunity, 'points' el punto simbólico de un efecto relocate (marcador {point}), y 'startZones', 'startFlanks' y 'stats' los literales de las funciones startsIn, startsOn y stat (marcadores {startZone}, {startFlank}, {stat}, {cells}). Los valores porcentuales se escriben y se leen en puntos porcentuales enteros. Las claves con sufijo 'Hint' de 'startZones' y 'startFlanks' NO las usa el generador: son la explicación larga que la pantalla de Equipo enseña en un tooltip al pasar el ratón por el nombre de la zona dentro de la descripción de un perk (AW-F).

layout.lethalRisk: it marks one opponent per activation, whoever is worst off, and may kill them even if healthy
layout.lethalContactRisk: it may kill the opponent involved in the play, even if healthy
layout.blocksSuffix: Closes {blocked} for the rest of the run.

effects.modifyKnockdownTicks: {target} leaves the opponent knocked down for longer with their tackles
effects.modifyKnockdownTicksDown: {target} leaves the opponent knocked down for less time with their tackles
effects.shiftHomeForward: {target} advances their home cell {value:abs} cells in their team's attacking direction
effects.shiftHomeBackward: {target} pulls back their home cell {value:abs} cells in their team's attacking direction
effects.modifyMarkBiasProtectLinked: protects {target} by marking whoever threatens them
effects.modifyMarkBiasAvoided: no rival marker wants to take on {target}
effects.modifyTackleBiasKnockedDown: {target} prefers to tackle the rival who is already down
effects.modifyTackleBiasFouled: goes after whoever fouled them last
effects.extraAction: {target} repeats the play in the same instant

triggers.MOB_START: when the mob storms the pitch

startZones.OwnThirdHint:
Columns 0 to 2 of the placement grid,
the three closest to their own goal.
What counts is the cell you line them up in,
not where they end up during the match.
startZones.MiddleHint:
Columns 3 to 5 of the placement grid.
The middle third of your eight columns,
not the centre circle of the pitch.
startZones.AttackingThirdHint:
Columns 6 and 7 of the placement grid,
the two most advanced you can line up in.
Not the opponent's half: nobody starts there.

startFlanks.LeftFlankHint:
Rows 0 and 1 of the grid: either one counts.
Left and right are taken from the player
facing the opposing goal.
startFlanks.CenterHint:
Row 2, the only row that is not a flank.
The other four are.
startFlanks.RightFlankHint:
Rows 3 and 4 of the grid: either one counts.
Left and right are taken from the player
facing the opposing goal.

eventEffects._doc: ADR 0100: pieces the effect line of an event option is composed from. Option text is never hand-written (RT-035).
eventEffects.injureMinor: leaves him with a minor injury
eventEffects.injureSevere: leaves him with a severe injury
